blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Cabinet Secretary Benjamin “Benhur” Abalos said that a five-year term for barangay and Sangguniang Kabataan (SK) officials is appropriate, because a longer period would give local officials more time to work while reducing the frequency of political divisions in communities. Abalos made the statement in Cebu on Sunday, September 27. That was just days after President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. signed Republic Act No. 12326.
